name: KernelPromptAssembler + VllmChatClient + run_frame

test_list.description: A bounded loopback server receives the production vLLM-compatible /tokenize request and /v1/chat/completions SSE request; the actual KernelPromptAssembler, KernelToolRunner, KernelFrameJournal, run_frame, CAS and PII vault are wired together, masked PII is absent from both HTTP bodies, and the durable synthetic Stop transcript retains the selected model and effort.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.description: A real local kernel frame with selected synthetic model and effort, session capability, CAS, tool runner and durable journal.

inputs.name: http_fixture
inputs.description: A bounded loopback-only fixture serving one synthetic /tokenize response followed by one synthetic OpenAI-compatible Stop SSE response.

output_description: One real local frame execution whose sanitized request is counted and dispatched with matching messages, tools and model, then durably journaled; tokenizer IDs/counts and verifier fingerprint are explicitly synthetic fixtures.
